review.notes: Word-level diff of the PDF text layer against the OCR markdown for all 20 physical pages plus a whole-document digit-token inventory. No code fences; Figures 1-6 are embedded as raster images, so their diagram labels (attn/eattn/wq/wk/wv, MLP) and chart-axis ticks (p.1 throughput plot, p.11 context-length plots) are figure-internal and not transcription defects. Grid-search table values (physical p.6) all match the print cell-for-cell on a 300 dpi render. Footnote 1 and the corresponding-author line on physical p.1 were dropped and are restored; the footnote marker superscript 1 sits on 'significant' in the introduction (verified in the text layer and on the p.1 render).
